messages.subject: Project Relay - diligence timetable & data room
messages.plaintextBody:
David,

Now that the LOI is countersigned, proposed diligence timetable:

- Data room live this week; index and Q&A protocol to follow.
- Locked-box accounts to be drawn to a Locked Box Date of 30 September 2024.
- Bracken's legal, financial and tax DD substantially complete within ~4 weeks of access.
- First SPA draft from us in early October; aim to exchange and complete in early November, inside the exclusivity period.

We'll also need access for the W&I underwriter once a policy is on foot. Shout if the timetable looks tight your end.

Tom

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Relay - diligence timetable & data room
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom, Elena,

Legal and financial DD is substantially there. Two findings to carry into the SPA and disclosure: (1) customer concentration - a handful of accounts above 5 per cent of turnover, so we want a tight customer/supplier warranty; and (2) a chunk of the delivery fleet is on operating leases, which the vehicle-fleet warranty and disclosure need to reflect. Otherwise no red flags that change the price.

Mark

Mark Ferris | Associate | Bracken Group Holdings
